title: project.inventory result
description: Every file the walk pinned, everything it deliberately left out, and the digest a directory source would record.

path.description: Path relative to the walked directory, so the inventory means the same thing wherever the tree is mounted.

omitted.description: Entries the walk deliberately left out, and why. Reported rather than silently skipped: a tree digest that quietly excluded something would pin fewer bytes than the directory holds, and nothing in it would say so.

tree_sha256.description: The digest a directory source would pin. Computed over every file the walk found, not over the reported ones: a cap is about the response, and letting it change the digest would make the pin depend on how much of the answer fit.
